flavorText: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.
name: Sprigatito

flavorText: The hardness of Floragato's fur depends on the Pokémon's mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.
name: Floragato

attacks.name: Flower Trick
attacks.text: Choose a spot from among your opponent's Active Spot and Bench. At the end of your opponent's next turn, do 70 damage to the Pokémon in the spot you chose.

flavorText: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.
name: Tarountula

attacks.name: Bind Down
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavorText: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.

attacks.name: Anbinden
attacks.text: Während des nächsten Zuges deines Gegners kann sich das Verteidigende Pokémon nicht zurückziehen.

name: Spidops

attacks.name: U-turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: It's highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.
name: Nymble

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

attacks.name: Absorber
attacks.text: Heile 10 Schadenspunkte bei diesem Pokémon.

name: Smoliv

flavorText: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.
name: Dolliv

abilities.name: Extra Heal
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon ex that has any Energy attached. If you do, discard a random Energy from that Pokémon.

flavorText: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.
name: Arboliva

flavorText: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.
name: Bramblin

attacks.name: Continuous Tumble
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

flavorText: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

attacks.name: Dauerrollen
attacks.text: Wirf so lang 1 Münze, bis zum ersten Mal das Ergebnis Zahl kommt. Diese Attacke fügt 60 Schadenspunkte pro Kopf zu.

name: Brambleghast

flavorText: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.
name: Capsakid

attacks.name: Red-Hot Headbutt
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Grass or Metal Pokémon, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavorText: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
name: Scovillain

attacks.name: Ball Roll
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

flavorText: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

attacks.name: Ballrolle
attacks.text: Wirf so lange 1 Münze, bis sie Zahl zeigt. Diese Attacke fügt 20 Schadenspunkte pro Kopf zu.

name: Rellor

attacks.name: Binding Greed
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost {C}{C} more.

flavorText: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

attacks.name: Fesselnde Gier
attacks.text: Während des nächsten Zuges deines Gegners erhöhen sich die Kosten der vom Verteidigenden Pokémon eingesetzten Attacken um {C}{C}.

name: Wo-Chien

attacks.name: Cheerful Singing
attacks.text: Put 1 random Basic Pokémon from your deck onto your Bench.

flavorText: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

attacks.text: Lege 1 zufälliges Basis-Pokémon aus deinem Deck auf deine Bank.

name: Fuecoco

flavorText: The valve in Crocalor's flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.
name: Crocalor

abilities.name: Passionate Voice
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may discard 1 Fire Energy from this Pokémon in order to use this Ability. During this turn, attacks used by your Fire Pokémon do +50 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Skeledirge

flavorText: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.
name: Charcadet

abilities.name: Armor
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes –30 damage from attacks.

attacks.name: Armor Cannon
attacks.text: Discard a {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rüstungskanone
attacks.text: Lege 1 {R}-Energie von diesem Pokémon auf deinen Ablagestapel.

attacks.name: Megafire of Envy
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavorText: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

attacks.name: Megafeuer des Neids
attacks.text: Wenn mindestens 1 deiner Pokémon während des letzten Zuges deines Gegners durch Schaden einer Attacke kampfunfähig wurde, fügt diese Attacke 60 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.

name: Chi-Yu

attacks.name: Splashing Dodge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavorText: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

attacks.name: Ausweichplatscher
attacks.text: Wirf 1 Münze. Verhindere bei Kopf während des nächsten Zuges deines Gegners allen Schaden durch und alle Effekte von Attacken, die diesem Pokémon zugefügt werden.

name: Quaxly

attacks.name: Splashing Turn
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

attacks.name: Platschende Drehung
attacks.text: Tausche dieses Pokémon gegen 1 Pokémon auf deiner Bank aus.

name: Quaxwell

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.text: If this Pokémon's remaining HP is 50 or less, attacks used by this Pokémon do +60 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.
name: Quaquaval

flavorText: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.
name: Wiglett

attacks.name: Triple Whip
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

flavorText: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

attacks.name: Tripelpeitsche
attacks.text: Wirf 3 Münzen. Diese Attacke fügt 30 Schadenspunkte pro Kopf zu.

name: Wugtrio

flavorText: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.
name: Finizen

attacks.name: Jet Punch
attacks.text: This attack also does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: This hero of the ocean swims at a speed of 50 knots and saves drowning people and Pokémon.

attacks.name: Düsenhieb
attacks.text: Diese Attacke fügt auch 1 Pokémon auf der Bank deines Gegners 50 Schadenspunkte zu.

name: Palafin

flavorText: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.
name: Cetoddle

attacks.name: Ice Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

attacks.name: Ice Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

name: Cetitan

attacks.name: Shedding Spiral
attacks.text: If you have no cards in your deck, this attack can be used for 1 Water Energy.

flavorText: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.
name: Veluza

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

flavorText: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

attacks.name: Gigastoß
attacks.text: Während deines nächsten Zuges kann dieses Pokémon nicht angreifen.

name: Dondozo

attacks.name: Rally Back
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavorText: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

attacks.name: Aufholjagd
attacks.text: Wenn mindestens 1 deiner Pokémon während des letzten Zuges deines Gegners durch Schaden einer Attacke kampfunfähig wurde, fügt diese Attacke 60 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.

name: Tatsugiri

flavorText: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.
name: Frigibax

flavorText: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.
name: Arctibax

abilities.name: Ice Maker
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may take a Water Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to the Water Pokémon in the Active Spot.

flavorText: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.
name: Baxcalibur

attacks.name: Diving Icicles
attacks.text: Discard all Water Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 130 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Random Spark
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavorText: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

attacks.name: Zufälliger Funke
attacks.text: Diese Attacke fügt 1 Pokémon deines Gegners 10 Schadenspunkte zu.

name: Pawmi

flavorText: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.
name: Pawmo

attacks.name: Thunder Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.
name: Pawmot

flavorText: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.
name: Tadbulb

attacks.name: High-Voltage Cannon
attacks.text: If you have 4 or more Lightning Energy in play, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavorText: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they're a popular delicacy.
name: Wattrel

flavorText: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There's hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.
name: Kilowattrel

attacks.name: Lightning Laser
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

attacks.name: Blitzlaser
attacks.text: Diese Attacke fügt auch 1 Pokémon auf der Bank deines Gegners 30 Schadenspunkte zu.

name: Miraidon

flavorText: The yeast in Fidough's breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.
name: Fidough

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavorText: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

attacks.name: Knuddler
attacks.text: Wirf 1 Münze. Bei Kopf fügt diese Attacke 50 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.

name: Dachsbun

attacks.name: Fighting Sword
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavorText: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon's evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

attacks.name: Kampfschwert
attacks.text: Wenn das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners ein Pokémon-{ex} ist, fügt diese Attacke 70 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.

name: Ceruledge

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

attacks.name: Psystrahl
attacks.text: Das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners ist jetzt verwirrt.

name: Rabsca

flavorText: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.
name: Flittle

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

attacks.name: Psychokinese
attacks.text: Diese Attacke fügt für jede an das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners angelegte Energie 20 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.

name: Espathra

attacks.name: Soul Shot
attacks.text: Discard a card from your hand. If you can't, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

attacks.text: Lege 1 Karte aus deiner Hand auf deinen Ablagestapel. Wenn du das nicht machen kannst, hat diese Attacke keine Auswirkungen.

name: Greavard

attacks.name: Last Respects
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Psychic Pokémon in your discard pile.

flavorText: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.
name: Houndstone

attacks.name: Continuous Coin Toss
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

flavorText: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dauermünzwurf
attacks.text: Wirf so lange 1 Münze, bis sie Zahl zeigt. Diese Attacke fügt 20 Schadenspunkte pro Kopf zu.

name: Gimmighoul

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

flavorText: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

attacks.name: Kratzfurie
attacks.text: Wirf 3 Münzen. Diese Attacke fügt 10 Schadenspunkte pro Kopf zu.

name: Mankey

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: This attack does more damage equal to the damage this Pokémon has on it.

flavorText: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

attacks.name: Raserei
attacks.text: Diese Attacke fügt zusätzlichen Schaden in Höhe des Schadens zu, der diesem Pokémon bereits zugefügt wurde.

name: Primeape

attacks.name: Dynamite Punch
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

flavorText: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

attacks.name: Dynamitstoß
attacks.text: Dieses Pokémon fügt auch sich selbst 30 Schadenspunkte zu.

name: Annihilape

flavorText: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.
name: Paldean Tauros

flavorText: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.
name: Toedscool

attacks.name: Stun Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavorText: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

attacks.name: Stachelspore
attacks.text: Wirf 1 Münze. Bei Kopf ist das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners jetzt paralysiert.

name: Toedscruel

attacks.name: Adrenaline Hammer
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

attacks.name: Adrenalinhammer
attacks.text: Dieses Pokémon ist jetzt verwirrt.

name: Klawf

attacks.name: Arrogant Impact
attacks.text: If this Pokémon's remaining HP is 60 or less, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.
name: Ting-Lu

attacks.name: Rampaging Fang
attacks.text: Discard 2 {R} Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

attacks.name: Tobende Fänge
attacks.text: Lege 2 {R} Energien von diesem Pokémon auf deinen Ablagestapel.

name: Koraidon

flavorText: It's dangerous for Wooper to travel alone. They line up in groups of three or four and help each other as they walk around the wetlands.
name: Paldean Wooper

attacks.name: Muddy Hammer
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

flavorText: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

attacks.name: Schlammhammer
attacks.text: Lege die oberste Karte vom Deck deines Gegners auf seinen Ablagestapel.

name: Paldean Clodsire

attacks.name: Rocket Jump
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can't stay in this mode for long.

attacks.name: Raketensprung
attacks.text: Wirf 1 Münze. Bei "Zahl" hat dieser Angriff keine Auswirkungen.

name: Lokix

flavorText: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.
name: Maschiff

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

flavorText: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

attacks.name: Wilder Tackle
attacks.text: Dieses Pokémon fügt auch sich selbst 20 Schadenspunkte zu.

name: Mabosstiff

flavorText: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.
name: Shroodle

attacks.name: Colorful Attack
attacks.text: If your Pokémon in play have 3 or more different types of Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavorText: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.
name: Grafaiai

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavorText: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

attacks.name: Fliegen
attacks.text: Wirf 1 Münze. Bei Zahl hat diese Attacke keine Auswirkungen. Verhindere bei Kopf während des nächsten Zuges deines Gegners allen Schaden durch und alle Effekte von Attacken, die diesem Pokémon zugefügt werden.

name: Bombirdier

flavorText: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.
name: Tinkatink

flavorText: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.
name: Tinkatuff

attacks.name: Gigaton Hammer
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Gigaton Hammer.

flavorText: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

attacks.name: Gigaton-Hammer
attacks.text: Während deines nächsten Zuges kann dieses Pokémon Gigaton-Hammer nicht einsetzen.

name: Tinkaton

flavorText: The steel section is Varoom's actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.
name: Varoom

attacks.name: Poison Gas
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavorText: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

attacks.name: Giftwolke
attacks.text: Das Aktive Pokémon deines Gegners ist jetzt vergiftet.

name: Revavroom

attacks.name: Iron Supply
attacks.text: Take a Metal Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.
name: Orthworm

attacks.name: Spending Rush
attacks.text: 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen at random for each Metal Energy attached to this Pokémon. For each time a Pokémon was chosen, do 40 damage to it.

flavorText: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.
name: Lechonk

attacks.name: Leg Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, during your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

flavorText: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.
name: Oinkologne

attacks.name: Double Hit
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

flavorText: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.
name: Tandemaus

attacks.name: Triple Gnawing
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: The little one just appeared one day. They all live together like a family, but the relationship between the three is still unclear.
name: Maushold

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavorText: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Wirf 1 Münze. Bei Kopf fügt diese Attacke 30 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.

name: Squawkabilly

attacks.name: Driving Buddy
attacks.text: If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavorText: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider's body heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts the Pokémon's spirit.

attacks.name: Mitfahrkumpel
attacks.text: Wenn du eine Unterstützerkarte während dieses Zuges aus deiner Hand gespielt hast, fügt diese Attacke 60 Schadenspunkte mehr zu.

name: Cyclizar

flavorText: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.
name: Flamigo
